reference_sql:
WITH weekly AS (
  -- one row per week of the range
  SELECT week_start, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM weekly_units
  WHERE week_start BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-06' AND DATE '2025-03-24'
  GROUP BY week_start
)
SELECT week_start, units,
  units - LAG(units) OVER (ORDER BY week_start) AS change_units
FROM weekly
alternatives:
WITH weeks AS (
  -- one row per week of the range
  SELECT DISTINCT week_start
  FROM calendar
  WHERE week_start BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-06' AND DATE '2025-03-24'
), sold AS (
  -- one row per week with orders
  SELECT order_week AS week_start, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_week BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-06' AND DATE '2025-03-24'
  GROUP BY order_week
), weekly AS (
  -- one row per week of the range
  SELECT w.week_start, COALESCE(s.units, 0) AS units
  FROM weeks w
  LEFT JOIN sold s ON s.week_start = w.week_start
)
SELECT week_start, units,
  units - LAG(units) OVER (ORDER BY week_start) AS change_units
FROM weekly

WITH weekly AS (
  -- one row per week of the range
  SELECT week_start, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM weekly_units
  WHERE week_start BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-06' AND DATE '2025-03-24'
  GROUP BY week_start
)
SELECT w.week_start, w.units, w.units - p.units AS change_units
FROM weekly w
LEFT JOIN weekly p ON p.week_start = w.week_start - INTERVAL 7 DAY

solver.query:
WITH weeks AS (
  SELECT CAST(w AS DATE) AS week_start
  FROM generate_series(DATE '2025-01-06', DATE '2025-03-24', INTERVAL 7 DAY) t(w)
), u AS (
  SELECT w.week_start, COALESCE(SUM(s.units), 0) AS units
  FROM weeks w
  LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.order_week = w.week_start
  GROUP BY w.week_start
)
SELECT week_start, units, units - LAG(units) OVER (ORDER BY week_start) AS change_units
FROM u
